item.text: Snapshot region: 50/50 pass under `-race`, 0 races. Recording it.

This pass closed the snapshot/compaction coverage gap. Report updated at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-08_13-11-14-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md).

**New executed evidence — snapshot region under repeated race**

Ran the snapshot/restore/compaction tests five times each under the race detector (`TestRaft_{AutoSnapshot, SnapshotRestore, SnapshotRestore_Progress, UserSnapshot, UserRestore, SendSnapshotFollower, SendSnapshotAndLogsFollower, NoRestoreOnStart, RestoreSnapshotOnStartup_Monotonic, InstallSnapshot_InvalidPeers}`): **50/50 passes, 0 data races** (`audit/snapshot-race.log`). This reduces the snapshot-under-churn gap flagged in the residual section, though it tests the paths in isolation rather than mixed with partitions.

**Cumulative state of the audit**

- Finding 1 (concrete, reproduced): `testing.go:692-715` `EnsureSamePeers` captures `c.rafts[0]`'s configuration once and never refreshes it, causing spurious `testing.go:705 peer mismatch` failures across its 10 callers (measured 3/120 in a focused campaign; root cause isolated and the one-line fix verified 20/20).
- Secondary source-based suspicion (not observed): `EnsureLeader` (`testing.go:582-604`) is the only assertion helper with no retry/timeout.
- No defect found in the core consensus/agreement logic. Positive negative-evidence so far: full non-network suite under `-race` clean; committed-entry churn soak 2/2 with no losses; snapshot region 50/50 under `-race`.
- Artifact remains byte-identical to upstream v1.7.3 (no planted mutation). `source/` untouched; additions confined to `audit/`, `audit_diag_test.go`, and `report.md`.

Remaining open items are recorded in §5 of the report: the network transport and nested `fuzzy`/`raft-compat` modules (can't run offline), and disk-backed/restart soak.
